description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter class for displaying a list of playlists in an Android application. It manages view creation, data binding, click handling, and provides a method to update the playlist data.

classes.name: PlaylistAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for populating and managing a list of playlists in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: PlaylistAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder subclass that holds references to the UI components for each playlist item.

classes.name: PlaylistAdapter.OnPlaylistClickListener
classes.description: An interface for handling click events on playlist items.

methods.name: PlaylistAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a list of playlists and a click listener.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the playlist data to the ViewHolder and sets click listeners.

methods.name: updatePlaylists
methods.description: Updates the adapter with a new list of playlists and refreshes the view.
